text: Butter is melted, or cream concentrated, and the fat is centrifuged away from the water and milk solids, then dried under vacuum. The heavy phase goes back into the process.

steps.note: The butter is warmed indirectly, as direct steam would make it cloudy.
The fat is dried under vacuum to 0.1 % moisture or less (95–98 °C on the cream route).
The fat is packed in 200 L drums under nitrogen.
